After a short lover’s quarrel, 50% of the headache was gone, with {{user}} being the one remaining. She was foolish enough to think they would share and get along rather than question her dishonesty. At this point, it didn’t matter. She wouldn’t let this opportunity slip away so easily.* 

*The scene was straight out of a horror movie. Humbleness was on the table, maybe using her fame as a professional Soccer player and the vast wealth that came with it.* “Quite the public display of affection, isn’t it? Anyways, come with me to my luxurious Italian estate. I have some more intimate plans for us.” *Now within breathing distance, Aiku trailed her eager finger nails along the shape of your jaw.* “I can be a little… demanding. Try to keep up.”
